sentences.en: It's Thursday, February 18th.
sentences.zh: 今天是2月18日，星期四。

sentences.en: Declan, when did you start covering Rwanda?
sentences.zh: 德克兰，你是什么时候开始报道卢旺达的？

sentences.en: I had just arrived in Africa as a freelance reporter.
sentences.zh: 我当时刚作为自由撰稿人抵达非洲。

sentences.en: It was the start of my career as a foreign correspondent.
sentences.zh: 那是我的外国常驻记者生涯的开始。

sentences.en: And one of the first assignments I took was to go from my base in Kenya to Rwanda.
sentences.zh: 我接到的首批任务之一，就是从我在肯尼亚的驻地前往卢旺达。

sentences.en: It had only been five years since the genocide.
sentences.zh: 那时距离种族灭绝过去才仅仅五年。

sentences.en: And I went over there to report on the fallout from that genocide that was still taking place.
sentences.zh: 我过去是为了报道那场仍在持续的种族灭绝所带来的余波。

sentences.en: And remind us about the Rwandan genocide.
sentences.zh: 请给我们讲讲卢旺达大屠杀吧。

sentences.en: I recall it as a singular atrocity.
sentences.zh: 我的印象中这是一场罕见的惨剧。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: Its roots really went back decades to the colonial period in Rwanda.
sentences.zh: 它的根源其实可以追溯到卢旺达的殖民时期，已有几十年历史。

sentences.en: It was colonized by Belgium.
sentences.zh: 它曾被比利时殖民。

sentences.en: And there are two main ethnic groups, the Hutu, who make up the majority of the population, and the Tutsi, who make up the minority.
sentences.zh: 当时有两个主要族群：占人口大多数的胡图族，以及占少数的图西族。

sentences.en: The divisions between these two groups preceding the colonial period were quite fluid.
sentences.zh: 在殖民时期之前，这两个族群之间的界限相当模糊。

sentences.en: But during colonialism, people have identity cards that identify them as either Hutu or Tutsi.
sentences.zh: 但在殖民统治期间，人们有了身份证，用来标明自己是胡图族还是图西族。

sentences.en: And as the colonial period comes to an end in the late 1950s, the Hutus claim power and effectively take over the country, pushing hundreds of thousands of Tutsis
sentences.zh: 随着殖民时期在20世纪50年代末走向结束，胡图族人宣称掌权并实际上接管了国家，将数十万图西族人

sentences.en: into exile abroad.
sentences.zh: 驱逐到国外流亡。

sentences.en: So a few decades pass with the Tutsis living abroad in refugee camps.
sentences.zh: 于是，几十年过去了，图西族人在国外的难民营中生活。

sentences.en: And then in
sentences.zh: 接着在

sentences.en: 1990, a small group of those Tutsi exiles form a militia.
sentences.zh: 1990年，一小群图西族流亡者组成了一支民兵武装。

sentences.en: They return to Rwanda to try to seize control.
sentences.zh: 他们返回卢旺达，企图夺取控制权。

sentences.en: Tensions build for two or three years.
sentences.zh: 紧张局势持续了两三年。

sentences.en: And suddenly, in 1994, they explode into this genocide.
sentences.zh: 突然间，在1994年，矛盾爆发成了这场种族灭绝。

sentences.en: It is not like anything I've ever seen in 30 years as a reporter.
sentences.zh: 这与我30年记者生涯中所见过的任何事情都不同。

sentences.en: This is the start of the bloodiest 100 days in human history.
sentences.zh: 这是人类历史上最血腥的100天的开始。

sentences.en: I've seen some of the most terrible things today that I've ever seen.
sentences.zh: 我今天看到的很多最可怕的事情，都是我前所未见的。

sentences.en: Gangs of Hutu militiamen take to the streets of Kigali, the capital, and across Rwanda.
sentences.zh: 成群结队的胡图族民兵走上首都基加利以及卢旺达全国的街头。

sentences.en: They got the identity cards, national identity cards.
sentences.zh: 他们拿着身份证，国民身份证。

sentences.en: All those who were supposed to be Tutsi were seated in one line.
sentences.zh: 所有被认为是图西族的人都被排成一队。

sentences.en: And set about systematically attacking members of the Tutsi minority.
sentences.zh: 并开始系统性地袭击图西族少数群体成员。

sentences.en: They cut off their fingers, they cut off their arms, they take out their eyes and they start to kill, kill, kill.
sentences.zh: 他们砍掉他们的手指，砍掉他们的手臂，挖出他们的眼睛，然后开始杀戮、杀戮、杀戮。

sentences.en: Hacking them to death with machetes.
sentences.zh: 用大砍刀将他们残忍砍死。

sentences.en: We're exposed to death every day and night.
sentences.zh: 我们日夜面临着死亡的威胁。

sentences.en: Neighbours killed neighbours.
sentences.zh: 邻居杀害了邻居。

sentences.en: Husbands even killed their Tutsi wives.
sentences.zh: 甚至连丈夫都杀害了他们身为图西族的妻子。

sentences.en: Members of the security forces, the police, the army, they join in the slaughter.
sentences.zh: 安全部队、警察、军队的成员也纷纷加入这场大屠杀。

sentences.en: It is open season on Tutsis in Rwanda.
sentences.zh: 在卢旺达，猎杀图西族人成了公开的行动。

sentences.en: It is, I think, the standard against which all future tragedies will be measured.
sentences.zh: 我认为，这成为了衡量未来所有悲剧的标准。

sentences.en: And at the same time, to the shame of the international community, there is silence.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，令国际社会羞耻的是，却是一片沉默。

sentences.en: Reports about the slaughter are coming out, but nothing happens.
sentences.zh: 关于屠杀的报道不断传出，但什么也没有发生。

sentences.en: And so this goes on for 100 days, and eventually ends in July of 1994, when the Tutsi rebel army makes its way back to Kigali, and they're led by this person called Paul Kagame.
sentences.zh: 这场屠杀持续了100天，并最终在1994年7月结束，当时图西族反叛军一路打回基加利，他们的领袖是一个叫保罗·卡加梅的人。

sentences.en: And what do we need to know about Paul Kagame?
sentences.zh: 关于保罗·卡加梅，我们需要了解些什么？

sentences.en: So Paul Kagame is this Rwandan Tutsi who has been raised in exile in refugee camps in neighbouring Uganda.
sentences.zh: 保罗·卡加梅是一名卢旺达图西族人，在邻国乌干达的难民营中流亡长大。

sentences.en: So we mainly focused on the very fact that there was need for change, and that these stateless people, ourselves, needed to come back home.
sentences.zh: 因此我们主要关注的事实是，这里亟需变革，而我们这些无国籍的人，必须返回家园。

sentences.en: And he joins this Tutsi rebel group so that they can return, after so many years in exile, to their home.
sentences.zh: 他加入了这个图西族反叛组织，以便在多年的流亡后重返家园。

sentences.en: So I was fighting for my own rights.
sentences.zh: 所以我是在为我自己的权利而战。

sentences.en: And he's known as this very cool, collected military commander who's been able to marshal the resources at his disposal and bring this conflict to a conclusion.
sentences.zh: 他以沉着冷静的军事指挥官著称，能够调配手头的资源，并最终结束了这场冲突。

sentences.en: And the genocide is over.
sentences.zh: 种族灭绝就这样结束了。

sentences.en: And so by the time I got to Rwanda a few years later,
sentences.zh: 因此，当我几年后到达卢旺达时，

sentences.en: Kagame was in the throes of this effort to rebuild the country.
sentences.zh: 卡加梅正全力投入到重建国家的努力中。

sentences.en: And what did that look like?
sentences.zh: 那是什么样子的呢？

sentences.en: One of the first things he does is to abolish the distinction between Hutus and Tutsis.
sentences.zh: 他做的第一件事之一就是废除胡图族和图西族之间的区分。

sentences.en: He outlaws any public mention of that distinction.
sentences.zh: 他取缔了任何公开提及这种区分的行为。

sentences.en: He removes it from the government ID cards, and he rips it out of all school textbooks.
sentences.zh: 他将其从政府身份证中删除，并从所有的学校教科书中撕掉。

sentences.en: So from then on, at least in public, Rwandans may no longer identify themselves as belonging to one group or another.
sentences.zh: 因此从那时起，至少在公开场合，卢旺达人不再被允许将自己标识为属于某个特定族群。

sentences.en: And he capitalizes on the collective shame of the international community.
sentences.zh: 他利用了国际社会的集体羞耻感。

sentences.en: Western countries in particular were really gripped by a sense of shame that they had failed to intervene during the genocide.
sentences.zh: 尤其是西方国家，因为在大屠杀期间未能进行干预而深感羞愧。

sentences.en: And so many countries were throwing aid at Rwanda to make amends for their own failings and also to help the country genuinely to move on.
sentences.zh: 因此，许多国家向卢旺达大量提供援助，以此来弥补他们自身的过失，同时也为了真正帮助这个国家向前看。

sentences.en: And Paul Kagame was proving to be a very efficient administrator and in some ways a model leader.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，保罗·卡加梅是一位非常高效的管理者，在某些方面堪称模范领导人。

sentences.en: He is engaging in these development projects, helping women, helping the poor.
sentences.zh: 他致力于这些发展项目，帮助女性，帮助穷人。

sentences.en: The country's economy starts to gradually pick up.
sentences.zh: 国家的经济开始逐渐复苏。

sentences.en: So very quickly, Rwanda becomes this country that, coming from this terrible tragedy, is this sort of unlikely African success story.
sentences.zh: 因此，很快地，卢旺达从这场可怕的悲剧走出来，成为了一个看似不可能的非洲成功故事。

sentences.en: Even at that point, Michael, there are some grumbles about Kagame.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，即使在那个时候，也有一些对卡加梅的抱怨。

sentences.en: There are some signs that he is, for all of that, quite a harsh leader.
sentences.zh: 有一些迹象表明，尽管如此，他仍然是一个相当严厉的领导人。

sentences.en: But by and large, the international community turns a blind eye to these signs.
sentences.zh: 但总的来说，国际社会对这些迹象视而不见。

sentences.en: As far as people are concerned, Rwanda has been through a terrible time.
sentences.zh: 在人们看来，卢旺达经历了一段可怕的时期。

sentences.en: And Kagame is really the country's best hope for a new beginning.
sentences.zh: 而卡加梅确实是这个国家迎来新生的最大希望。

sentences.en: And that's pretty much how the world understands the story of Rwanda.
sentences.zh: 世界对卢旺达故事的理解大致就是这样。

sentences.en: Until 2004.
We have been abandoned.
sentences.zh: 我们被抛弃了。

sentences.en: When a new story emerges.
sentences.zh: 一个新故事浮出水面。

sentences.en: There will be no rescue.
sentences.zh: 没有人会来救援。

sentences.en: In the form of a Hollywood movie.
sentences.zh: 以好莱坞电影的形式。

sentences.en: We need to help one another.
sentences.zh: 我们需要互相帮助。

sentences.en: That is the only thing that is keeping us alive.
sentences.zh: 这是让我们活下去的唯一办法。

sentences.en: Hotel Rwanda.
sentences.zh: 《卢旺达饭店》。

sentences.en: And Hotel Rwanda centers on the story of a man called Paul Rusasabagina.
sentences.zh: 《卢旺达饭店》围绕着一个名叫保罗·鲁萨萨巴吉纳的人的故事展开。

sentences.en: Yes, sir.
sentences.zh: 好的，长官。

sentences.en: Paul Rusasabagina, the house manager.
sentences.zh: 保罗·鲁萨萨巴吉纳，酒店经理。

sentences.en: Who was the manager of Kigali's best hotel during the genocide in 1994.
sentences.zh: 他是1994年大屠杀期间基加利最好的酒店的经理。

sentences.en: The Mikolin is an oasis of calm.
sentences.zh: 米科林酒店是一片平静的绿洲。

sentences.en: And Rusasabagina, who is himself a Hutu, uses his wiles and his charm and the resources at his disposal to prevent militiamen from entering the hotel and killing his guests.
sentences.zh: 而鲁萨萨巴吉纳本人是一名胡图族人，他运用自己的机智、魅力和手头的资源，阻止民兵进入酒店杀害他的客人们。

sentences.en: I will give you 100,000 francs.
sentences.zh: 我给你10万法郎。

sentences.en: I swear.
sentences.zh: 我发誓。

sentences.en: 100,000 francs.
sentences.zh: 10万法郎。

sentences.en: I will get you the money.
sentences.zh: 我会把钱拿给你的。

sentences.en: So he gives free beer to extremist commanders.
sentences.zh: 于是他向极端主义指挥官提供免费啤酒。

sentences.en: He bribes them with cigars and bottles of expensive whiskey.
sentences.zh: 他用雪茄和昂贵的威士忌贿赂他们。

sentences.en: He takes dollars out of the hotel safe and gives it to commanders to persuade them to go away and not to turn their machetes and their guns on his guests.
sentences.zh: 他从酒店保险箱里拿出美元送给指挥官，说服他们离开，不要把大砍刀和枪口对准他的客人。

sentences.en: And it's because of Paul Rusasabagina that when the genocide ends, everyone inside the hotel makes it out alive.
sentences.zh: 正因为保罗·鲁萨萨巴吉纳，当大屠杀结束时，酒店里的所有人都活着走了出去。

sentences.en: You are a good friend, Rusasabagina.
sentences.zh: 你是个好朋友，鲁萨萨巴吉纳。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: And this movie, as I recall, was a very big event in Hollywood and in our understanding of Rwanda.
sentences.zh: 我记得这部电影在好莱坞以及我们对卢旺达的理解中是一个非常大的事件。

sentences.en: Oh, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 哦，绝对是的。

sentences.en: It is an instant success.
sentences.zh: 它取得了巨大的成功。

sentences.en: At the premiere in Los Angeles, Paul Rusasabagina is photographed beside Matt Damon and Angelina Jolie and Harrison Ford.
sentences.zh: 在洛杉矶的首映式上，保罗·鲁萨萨巴吉纳与马特·达蒙、安吉丽娜·朱莉和哈里森·福特并肩合影。

sentences.en: He goes on the media circuit in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 他在美国的各大媒体上亮相。

sentences.en: He is celebrated by people like Oprah Winfrey.
sentences.zh: 他受到了奥普拉·温弗瑞等名人的赞誉。

sentences.en: And then in 2005.
sentences.zh: 然后是在2005年。

sentences.en: Paul has insisted, quote, I'm not a hero.
sentences.zh: 保罗坚持说：“我不是英雄。

sentences.en: I'm simply a man who made a decision to hold on to my family, my life and my beliefs until the end.
sentences.zh: 我只是一个决定坚守家人、生命和信念直到最后的人。”

sentences.en: President Bush awards him America's highest civilian honor, the Presidential Medal of Freedom.
sentences.zh: 布什总统授予他美国最高平民荣誉——总统自由勋章。

sentences.en: But the world came to know the story and people everywhere can recognize heroism.
sentences.zh: 但世界开始了解这个故事，世界各地的人们都能认出英雄主义。

sentences.en: So here's this guy who nobody knew about before the movie.
sentences.zh: 所以，这就是这个在电影上映前默默无闻的家伙。

sentences.en: At the time, he was actually driving a taxi and living in Belgium, where he and his family had fled as refugees after the genocide.
sentences.zh: 当时，他其实在开出租车，住在比利时，他和大屠杀后逃难至此的家人一起生活在那里。

sentences.en: And now suddenly he's in the White House telling his story to President Bush and being celebrated across the U.S.
sentences.zh: 而现在他突然出现在白宫，向布什总统讲述他的故事，并受到全美各地的赞颂。

sentences.en: He arguably becomes the most famous Rwandan on the planet.
sentences.zh: 可以说，他成了地球上最著名的卢旺达人。

sentences.en: Words can be the best or the worst weapon in a human being's arsenal.
sentences.zh: 言语可以是人类武器库中最好或最坏的武器。

sentences.en: More famous even than the president.
sentences.zh: 甚至比总统还要出名。

sentences.en: My message is to ask you to stand up.
sentences.zh: 我的信息是呼吁大家站出来。

sentences.en: We have stood by for so long.
sentences.zh: 我们作壁上观已经太久了。

sentences.en: Let us all together, hand in hand, stand up.
sentences.zh: 让我们所有人手挽着手，站出来。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: And so how does Rwanda's president, Paul Kagame, respond to all this?
sentences.zh: 那么卢旺达总统保罗·卡加梅对这一切作何反应？

sentences.en: Well, in the beginning, Paul Kagame likes the movie Hotel Rwanda.
sentences.zh: 嗯，一开始，保罗·卡加梅挺喜欢《卢旺达饭店》这部电影。

sentences.en: He welcomes the director to Kigali, where they host a premiere of the movie.
sentences.zh: 他欢迎导演来到基加利，并在那里举办了电影首映式。

sentences.en: Later, he courts some of the stars of the movie, like the actor Don Cheadle, who he invites to his palace in Rwanda.
sentences.zh: 后来，他结交了一些电影明星，比如演员唐·钱德尔，他邀请对方来到他在卢旺达的官邸。

sentences.en: But then things start to go wrong when Paul Russobagina publishes his memoir, in which he sharply criticizes Kagame and the way he's governed the country since taking power.
sentences.zh: 但随后事情开始变糟，保罗·鲁萨萨巴吉纳出版了他的回忆录，书中严厉批评了卡加梅以及他掌权以来的治国方式。

sentences.en: And if you like, I can read you a small extract from that memoir.
sentences.zh: 如果你愿意的话，我可以为你朗读那本回忆录中的一小段摘录。

sentences.en: Please.
sentences.zh: 请吧。

sentences.en: So he wrote,
sentences.zh: 他写道：

sentences.en: Rwanda is a country that has never known democracy.
sentences.zh: 卢旺达是一个从未经历过民主的国家。

sentences.en: The current president, Paul Kagame, has exhibited many characteristics of the classic African strongman since taking power.
sentences.zh: 现任总统保罗·卡加梅自掌权以来，表现出了许多典型非洲强人的特征。

sentences.en: He was re-elected with 95% of the vote.
sentences.zh: 他以95%的得票率再次当选。

sentences.en: And there's nobody in the world that can call results like that a free election and keep a straight face.
sentences.zh: 世界上没有人能把这样的选举结果称为自由选举，还能面不改色。

sentences.en: Rwanda is today a nation governed by and for the benefit of a small group of Tutsis.
sentences.zh: 如今的卢旺达是一个由一小撮图西族统治并为他们谋利的国家。

sentences.en: We have changed the dancers, but the music remains the same.
sentences.zh: 我们换了舞者，但音乐依然如故。

sentences.en: And then he does something even more confrontational.
sentences.zh: 接着他做了一件更具对抗性的事情。

sentences.en: He writes a letter to the International Criminal Tribunal for Rwanda recommending that war crime charges be brought against Kagame.
sentences.zh: 他写信给卢旺达问题国际刑事法庭，建议对卡加梅提起战争罪指控。

sentences.en: Second, were these things that Paul Russobagina wrote, were they fair?
sentences.zh: 其次，保罗·鲁萨萨巴吉纳写的这些事情，它们公道吗？

sentences.en: Were they accurate?
sentences.zh: 它们准确吗？

sentences.en: By and large, they were.
sentences.zh: 总的来说，是的。

sentences.en: During the 94 genocide, it wasn't just the Hutu extremists who were doing the killing.
sentences.zh: 在94年的大屠杀中，进行杀戮的不仅仅是胡图族极端分子。

sentences.en: There were also credible and confirmed reports that some of President Kagame's soldiers, the Tutsi rebels, had also carried out violence against civilians.
sentences.zh: 还有可靠且经过证实的报道称，卡加梅总统的一些士兵，即图西族叛军，也对平民实施了暴力行为。

sentences.en: And after the genocide, when Kagame's soldiers took over the country, they also went into some of these camps that were filled with Hutus and slaughtered thousands of civilians.
sentences.zh: 大屠杀结束后，当卡加梅的士兵接管国家时，他们也进入了一些挤满胡图族的难民营，并屠杀了数千名平民。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: So, many Rwandan Hutus fled across the border into neighbouring Congo because they were afraid to come home.
sentences.zh: 因此，许多卢旺达胡图族人逃过边境进入邻国刚果，因为他们害怕回家。

sentences.en: At the same time, back in Rwanda, Paul Kagame starts to take measures to tighten his grip on power.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，在卢旺达国内，保罗·卡加梅开始采取措施收紧权力。

sentences.en: He changes the constitution for more terMs.
sentences.zh: 他修改了宪法以延长任期。

sentences.en: He starts to win elections by improbable margins, like 99% of the vote.
sentences.zh: 他开始以惊人的优势赢得选举，例如获得 99% 的选票。

sentences.en: And some of his political opponents inside Rwanda start to come under incredible pressure.
sentences.zh: 他在卢旺达国内的一些政治对手开始承受难以想象的压力。

sentences.en: Rwandan police has arrested Dan Shima Rui Gara, a leading critic of President Paul Kagame, charging her with forgery and...
sentences.zh: 卢旺达警方逮捕了保罗·卡加梅总统的主要批评者丹·希马·鲁伊·加拉，指控她伪造文件以及……

sentences.en: Some people who stand against him for election are prosecuted.
sentences.zh: 一些参加竞选反对他的人遭到起诉。

sentences.en: Andres Rui Zareka was found murdered.
sentences.zh: 安德烈斯·鲁伊·扎雷卡被发现遭谋杀。

sentences.en: His head almost entirely severed from his body.
sentences.zh: 他的头部几乎完全与身体分离。

sentences.en: Some start to disappear and even die.
sentences.zh: 有些人开始失踪甚至死亡。

sentences.en: Critics of Kagame abroad also start to come under attack.
sentences.zh: 卡加梅在海外的批评者也开始遭到袭击。

sentences.en: In a statement, authorities said his body was found on the bed and there were signs he was strangled.
sentences.zh: 当局在声明中称，他的尸体在床上被发现，并且有被勒死的迹象。

sentences.en: In South Africa, you have a former intelligence chief who's found dead in his hotel room.
sentences.zh: 在南非，人们发现前情报局长死在酒店房间里。

sentences.en: The Rwandan defence minister said in relation to that murdered former intelligence chief, when you choose to be a dog, you die like a dog.
sentences.zh: 卢旺达国防部长针对这位被谋杀的前情报局长表示，当你选择当一条狗时，你就会像狗一样死去。

sentences.en: In Kenya, a former Rwandan minister is found shot dead in his car.
sentences.zh: 在肯尼亚，一名卢旺达前部长被发现中枪死在自己的车里。

sentences.en: In Belgium, there's a fugitive Rwandan politician who's found floating in a canal.
sentences.zh: 在比利时，一名在逃的卢旺达政治家被发现漂浮在运河里。

sentences.en: And in London, the Metropolitan Police come to a number of Rwandan exiles and warn them that they are being hunted by Rwandan government agents who are trying to kill them.
sentences.zh: 在伦敦，伦敦警察厅找到多名卢旺达流亡者，警告他们正遭到试图杀死他们的卢旺达政府特工的追捕。

sentences.en: However, the president is reported to have said it's a matter of time.
sentences.zh: 然而，据报道总统曾表示这只是时间问题。

sentences.en: Whoever betrayed the nation cannot escape the consequences.
sentences.zh: 任何背叛国家的人都逃不掉后果。

sentences.en: All of this seems to suggest that to cross President Kagame is a very dangerous thing to do.
sentences.zh: 所有这一切似乎都表明，与卡加梅总统作对是一件非常危险的事情。

sentences.en: And I have to think that when Paul Versace Baguina is speaking out, writing what he wrote in his book, making these direct critiques of Kagame,
sentences.zh: 我不禁想到，当保罗·韦尔萨奇·巴吉纳公开直言、在书中写下那些内容、对卡加梅进行直接批评时，

sentences.en: he understands that he may be putting his own life at risk.
sentences.zh: 他明白自己可能正将自己的生命置于危险之中。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: He knows that he's frontally taking on the most powerful man in Rwanda.
sentences.zh: 他知道自己是在正面挑战卢旺达最权势的人。

sentences.en: He's attacking his reputation abroad.
sentences.zh: 他正在攻击对方在海外的声誉。

sentences.en: And he's also saying that Kagame should be prosecuted for war crimes.
sentences.zh: 他还表示应该因战争罪起诉卡加梅。

sentences.en: So in so doing, he's setting himself up as one of the most prominent and vocal critics of President Kagame.
sentences.zh: 因此，通过这样做，把自己塑造成卡加梅总统最著名、最直言不讳的批评者之一。

sentences.en: And he knows that he's playing with fire.
sentences.zh: 他知道自己在玩火。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 纽约时报应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁版？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 大家都知道你需要订阅时报才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但是，如果你能免费体验时报一个月，且无需绑定信用卡呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当您首次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，您在应用中的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间突破付费墙，看看时报订阅者每天都能获得什么内容。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果您尚未订阅《纽约时报》，请立即下载时报应用程序并获得 30 天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: Hi there.
sentences.zh: 你好。

sentences.en: Hi, Michael.
sentences.zh: 你好，迈克尔。

sentences.en: Nice to meet you.
sentences.zh: 很高兴见到你。

sentences.en: So, to introduce you, you are Abdi Latif.
sentences.zh: 介绍一下，你是阿布迪·拉蒂夫。

sentences.en: You are based in Nairobi.
sentences.zh: 你常驻内罗毕。

sentences.en: You're from there.
sentences.zh: 你是那里人。

sentences.en: And you have been covering East Africa for the Times for years.
sentences.zh: 你多年来一直为时报报道东非新闻。

sentences.en: So, I wonder if you could pick up this story where Declan Walsh left off.
sentences.zh: 我想知道你是否可以接着德克兰·沃尔什的话题继续讲下去。

sentences.en: Paul Rusesabagina is very quickly becoming a public enemy of Rwandan President Kagame, based on speeches and the publication of a memoir.
sentences.zh: 根据演讲和回忆录的出版，保罗·卢瑟萨巴吉纳迅速成为卢旺达总统卡加梅的公众敌人。

sentences.en: So, what happens next?
sentences.zh: 那么，接下来发生了什么？

sentences.en: So, in 2009, things started getting very hairy for Paul Rusesabagina.
sentences.zh: 因此，在 2009 年，保罗·卢瑟萨巴吉纳的情况开始变得非常棘手。

sentences.en: First, his house is broken into.
sentences.zh: 首先，他的房子被盗了。

sentences.en: Pictures were moved around and sheets were removed from the bed.
sentences.zh: 照片被移位，床单被拿掉了。

sentences.en: They stole his laptop and documents.
sentences.zh: 他们偷走了他的笔记本电脑和文件。

sentences.en: And later, he was almost run off the road while driving his car.
sentences.zh: 后来，他在开车时差点被人逼出路面。

sentences.en: And so, Paul Rusesabagina and his family took that as a message from the government that, we're watching you.
sentences.zh: 因此，保罗·卢瑟萨巴吉纳和他的家人将此视为政府发出的一个信息：我们在盯着你。

sentences.en: We know that we can reach you anytime.
sentences.zh: 我们知道随时都能找到你。

sentences.en: Don't think you're safe in Belgium, even though you're so far away from Rwanda.
sentences.zh: 别以为你在比利时就很安全，尽管你离卢旺达那么远。

sentences.en: So, in the family's mind and in his mind, these break-ins and this attempt to run him off the road feel like a coordinated campaign of harassment
sentences.zh: 因此，在家人和他自己看来，这些入室盗窃和将他逼出路面的企图感觉像是一场有组织的骚扰活动，

sentences.en: that they suspect can be traced back to President Kagame.
sentences.zh: 他们怀疑这可以追溯到卡加梅总统。

sentences.en: Yes, exactly.
sentences.zh: 是的，完全正确。

sentences.en: And he responds to these harassments by making a very big decision.
sentences.zh: 他通过做出一个重大决定来回应这些骚扰。

sentences.en: He decides that Belgium is no longer safe and that he wants to move to the United States.
sentences.zh: 他认为比利时不再安全，并希望移居美国。

sentences.en: And so, he and his family, they find a home in San Antonio, Texas, in this gated community.
sentences.zh: 于是，他和家人在德克萨斯州圣安东尼奥的一个封闭式社区里找到了一个家。

sentences.en: And living there gives him the space to continue his campaign criticizing the government of Rwanda.
sentences.zh: 住在那里的他有了空间，可以继续他批评卢旺达政府的活动。

sentences.en: Welcome to the program.
sentences.zh: 欢迎来到本节目。

sentences.en: It's been 20 years since the genocide.
sentences.zh: 大屠杀已经过去 20 年了。

sentences.en: What are your feelings 20 years later?
sentences.zh: 20 年后的你有什么感受？

sentences.en: He continues talking about how much the country that he loves has become an autocracy, that he is not safe going back to.
sentences.zh: 他继续谈到他热爱的国家是如何变成一个独裁政权的，以及他现在回去并不安全。

sentences.en: So, 20 years later, we see that all of those people who advocate for human rights are put in prison.
sentences.zh: 因此，20 年后，我们看到所有那些倡导人权的人都被投入了监狱。

sentences.en: People who have inflated the country went to exile, being followed into exile to kill them.
sentences.zh: 那些推崇这个国家的人流亡海外，却遭到追杀。

sentences.en: One of them is...
sentences.zh: 其中之一是……

sentences.en: And whenever Paul Recessa Beginner is calling for change in Rwanda...
sentences.zh: 每当保罗·卢瑟萨巴吉纳呼吁卢旺达改变时……

sentences.en: The only better future for Rwanda and the region would be to silence guns.
sentences.zh: 卢旺达和该地区唯一更好的未来就是让枪声停息。

sentences.en: He's always calling for peaceful change.
sentences.zh: 他一直在呼吁和平变革。

sentences.en: He's being true to the humanitarian figure the world knows him to be.
sentences.zh: 他一直保持着世人所知的人道主义者的形象。

sentences.en: By dialogue, we then find a lasting peace.
sentences.zh: 通过对话，我们才能找到持久的和平。

sentences.en: So, Paul Recessa Beginner spends the next decade spreading this message, criticizing Kagame, calling for peaceful reform in Rwanda.
sentences.zh: 因此，保罗·卢瑟萨巴吉纳在接下来的十年里一直在传播这一信息，批评卡加梅，呼吁卢旺达进行和平改革。

sentences.en: But the facts on the ground remain pretty much the same.
sentences.zh: 但现实情况几乎保持不变。

sentences.en: Kagame faces no serious challenge to his rule and continues to tighten his grip on power.
sentences.zh: 卡加梅的统治没有面临任何严重的挑战，并继续加强对权力的控制。

sentences.en: And all the while, thousands of Hutu refugees are still living in camps in the Congo and in other neighboring countries,
sentences.zh: 与此同时，数以千计的胡图族难民仍然住在刚果和其他邻国的难民营中，

sentences.en: sometimes in pretty tough conditions, decades after they left Rwanda.
sentences.zh: 有时是在相当恶劣的条件下，距离他们离开卢旺达已经过去了几十年。

sentences.en: And in these camps, some Hutus are actually forming militias and agitating to go home.
sentences.zh: 在这些难民营中，一些胡图族人实际上正在组建民兵组织，并煽动回国。

sentences.en: So, before the genocide, you had Tutsis outside the country agitating to come home.
sentences.zh: 因此，在大屠杀之前，国外有图西族人在煽动回国。

sentences.en: And now the roles have flipped.
sentences.zh: 现在角色互换了。

sentences.en: That's exactly right, Michael.
sentences.zh: 完全正确，迈克尔。

sentences.en: And then in 2018, in the midst of all this tension...
sentences.zh: 然后在 2018 年，在所有这些紧张局势中……

sentences.en: Fellow Rwandans, friends of Rwanda...
sentences.zh: 卢旺达同胞们，卢旺达的朋友们……

sentences.en: A video emerges online of Paul Recessa Beginner giving a speech.
sentences.zh: 网上出现了一段保罗·卢瑟萨巴吉纳发表演讲的视频。

sentences.en: And he says something he's never said before.
sentences.zh: 他说了一些他从未说过的话。

sentences.en: The time has come for us to use any means possible to bring about change in Rwanda.
sentences.zh: 我们使用一切可能的手段来实现卢旺达变革的时机已经成熟。

sentences.en: As all political means have been tried and failed.
sentences.zh: 因为所有政治手段都已尝试过，但都失败了。

sentences.en: He says that the time for us has come to use any means possible to bring about change in Rwanda.
sentences.zh: 他说，我们使用一切可能的手段来实现卢旺达变革的时机已经到来。

sentences.en: It is time to attempt our last resort.
sentences.zh: 是时候尝试我们的最后手段了。

sentences.en: And he pledges support for this armed rebel group made up of Hutu refugees called the National Liberation Forces, also known as the FLN.
sentences.zh: 他承诺支持这个由胡图族难民组成的名为“全国解放阵线”（也称为FLN）的武装叛乱组织。

sentences.en: Hence, I plead my unreserved support that National Liberation Forces launches against the Kagame army in order to free the Rwandan people.
sentences.zh: 因此，我坚决支持全国解放阵线对卡加梅军队发动的进攻，以便解放卢旺达人民。

sentences.en: This group was at the time being accused by the Rwandan government of killing innocent Rwandans, kidnapping people, looting property along the southern borders of the country.
sentences.zh: 当时，该组织正被卢旺达政府指控杀害无辜的卢旺达人、绑架民众、在南部边境沿线掠夺财产。

sentences.en: I wish all Rwandans, friends of Rwanda, a happy and blessed Christmas and a prosperous new year.
sentences.zh: 我祝愿所有卢旺达人、卢旺达的朋友们圣诞快乐、福杯满盈、新年快乐。

sentences.en: Viva justice, peace and democracy for all of us.
sentences.zh: 我们所有人的正义、和平与民主万岁。

sentences.en: God bless Rwanda.
sentences.zh: 上帝保佑卢旺达。

sentences.en: What do you make of this drastic change in Paul Recessa Beginner's messaging?
sentences.zh: 你如何看待保罗·卢瑟萨巴吉纳言论的这种急剧转变？

sentences.en: You know, it just showed for me, it just showed like the political reality in Rwanda and how exiled opponents were very much tired or angry at the government of Paul Kagame,
sentences.zh: 你知道，对我来说，这恰恰展现了卢旺达的政治现实，以及流亡反对派对保罗·卡加梅政府是如何的厌倦或愤怒，

sentences.en: basically turned to more extreme measures.
sentences.zh: 以至于基本上转向了更极端的手段。

sentences.en: So to you, it was a sign of desperation.
sentences.zh: 所以对你来说，这是一个绝望的信号。

sentences.en: It was definitely a message that we have tried our best, but they're not listening to us.
sentences.zh: 这绝对是在传达这样一个信息：我们已经尽了最大努力，但他们不听我们的。

sentences.en: And so we're going to take the war to them.
sentences.zh: 所以我们要把战火带给他们。

sentences.en: And then in August of last year.
sentences.zh: 然后是在去年八月。

sentences.en: Rwanda is suspected to be the founder or leader or sponsor or member of violent armed extremist terror.
sentences.zh: 卢旺达被怀疑是暴力武装极端恐怖主义的创立者、领导者、赞助者或成员。

sentences.en: We get news that Paul Recessa Beginner has disappeared from his home in Texas.
sentences.zh: 我们得到消息称，保罗·卢瑟萨巴吉纳在德克萨斯州的家中失踪了。

sentences.en: Paul Recessa Beginner was arrested and he is currently detained at Remera police station while his case fire is being processed in accordance with Rwandan criminal procedure.
sentences.zh: 保罗·卢瑟萨巴吉纳已被捕，目前被关押在雷梅拉警察局，其案件档案正根据卢旺达刑事诉讼程序进行处理。

sentences.en: And has actually been arrested in the Rwandan capital, Kigali.
sentences.zh: 并且实际上在卢旺达首都基加利被捕了。

sentences.en: Wait, how did that happen?
sentences.zh: 等等，这是怎么发生的？

sentences.en: Why would he ever be back in Rwanda knowing everything?
sentences.zh: 明知这一切，他怎么会回到卢旺达？

sentences.en: He knows he has moved as far away from Rwanda as humanly possible to avoid the Kagame government.
sentences.zh: 他知道自己为了避开卡加梅政府，已经搬到了距离卢旺达最远的人类极限距离。

sentences.en: It was a shock.
sentences.zh: 这是一个震惊。

sentences.en: It was a huge shock.
sentences.zh: 这是一个巨大的震惊。

sentences.en: The government was basically using that 2018 video where Paul Recessa Beginner pledges support for the FLN to justify arresting him on terrorism charges.
sentences.zh: 政府基本上是利用 2018 年的那段视频（保罗·卢瑟萨巴吉纳在视频中承诺支持 FLN）来为以恐怖主义罪名逮捕他进行辩护。

sentences.en: Now, Paul Recessa Beginner is a United States resident and a Belgian citizen.
sentences.zh: 现在，保罗·卢瑟萨巴吉纳是美国居民和比利时公民。

sentences.en: And you typically need a formal extradition process for repatriating someone.
sentences.zh: 遣返某人通常需要正式的引渡程序。

sentences.en: So my colleagues and I are all trying to figure out how did they get him to Rwanda.
sentences.zh: 所以我和我的同事们都在试图弄清楚他们是如何把他弄到卢旺达的。

sentences.en: Okay, heading to passport control.
sentences.zh: 好了，前往护照检查处。

sentences.en: So much hands sanitizing.

sentences.zh: 我们在11点采访到卢瑟萨巴吉纳。

sentences.en: So we have that.

sentences.en: Great.

sentences.zh: 你知道我是个老头子，我需要确保安全，尽量保证安全吗？

sentences.en: Great.

sentences.zh: 好的，非常感谢您接受我们的采访，保罗先生。

sentences.zh: 我想在一开始就明确记录在案，你是出于你自己的意愿和自主选择来做这件事的。

sentences.zh: 是这样吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Right after I sat in front of him is when I noticed that there was a camera hanging on top of the room where he was.

sentences.en: At that point, I sort of realized that he might not be able to talk to me freely, that he was definitely speaking under duress.

sentences.en: How have you been, how are you, since the two weeks?
sentences.zh: 自从这两周以来，你过得怎么样，身体还好吗？

sentences.zh: 嗯，我过得很好。

sentences.zh: 我一直过得很好。

sentences.zh: 我在这里受到了热烈的欢迎。

sentences.en: They even clean my room sometimes.
sentences.zh: 他们有时甚至帮我打扫房间。

sentences.zh: 他们给我提供食物。

sentences.en: I eat sometimes.

sentences.en: So they are very kind.
sentences.zh: 所以他们非常善良。

sentences.en: So everything has been smooth so far, so good.
sentences.zh: 所以目前一切都很顺利，目前为止还不错。

sentences.en: Could you tell us a little bit about how you got here?
sentences.zh: 你能跟我们讲讲你是怎么来到这里的吗？

sentences.en: How I got here, that is a surprise.
sentences.zh: 我怎么来到这里的，那真是一个惊喜。

sentences.en: He told me...
sentences.zh: 他告诉我……

sentences.en: I thought I was landing in Bojapura.
sentences.zh: 我以为我要在布加普拉降落。

sentences.en: He had been invited by a friend to speak in Burundi.
sentences.zh: 他曾应朋友邀请前往布隆迪演讲。

sentences.en: But when he landed, he realized he was in Rwanda.
sentences.zh: 但当他降落时，他发现自己在卢旺达。

sentences.en: What did you feel like when you got out of a plane and the soldiers were surrounding you and you knew that you were in Kikali?
sentences.zh: 当你走下飞机，士兵们包围了你，而你知道自己身在基加利时，你是什么感觉？

sentences.en: Imagine how you would feel if you fancied yourself where you're not supposed to be.
sentences.zh: 想象一下，如果你发现自己在一个本不该去的地方，你会是什么感觉。

sentences.en: And then I asked him about what brought him there.
sentences.zh: 然后我问他是什么把他带到了那里。

sentences.en: His political opposition to Kagame, including his support for the militia group, the FLN.
sentences.zh: 他对卡加梅的政治反对，包括他对民兵组织“民族解放阵线”（FLN）的支持。

sentences.en: Let's talk a little bit about the charges and the issues that you're facing in court.
sentences.zh: 让我们简单谈谈你在法庭上面临的指控和问题。

sentences.en: What pushed you into opposition, political opposition?
sentences.zh: 是什么促使你走上反对派道路，从事政治反对活动的？

sentences.en: When you're not satisfied by what is going on, then you go to opposition.
sentences.zh: 当你对现状不满意时，你就会走向反对派。

sentences.en: Yeah?
sentences.zh: 是吗？

sentences.en: This is why I raised the voice.
sentences.zh: 这就是我发出声音的原因。

sentences.en: You'll notice that in 2005-2006.
I was not talking.
sentences.zh: 我当时没有说话。

sentences.en: I was not in politics.
sentences.zh: 我没有参与政治。

sentences.en: Many years when I just say, okay, maybe things are going to improve and be better.
sentences.zh: 很多年里我都只是在想，好吧，也许事情会有所改善，会变得更好。

sentences.en: What about the FLN?
sentences.zh: 那民族解放阵线呢？

sentences.en: The FLN is not a terrorist organization.
sentences.zh: 民族解放阵线不是一个恐怖组织。

sentences.en: They are people who are really tired to live outside the country in refugee camps, without schools for children, without food, under the rain, under the sun.
sentences.zh: 他们是一群真正厌倦了生活在国外的难民营中、孩子没有学校上、没有食物、风吹日晒的人。

sentences.en: Those people, they need attention.
sentences.zh: 这些人需要关注。

sentences.en: And our main objective was to attract attention.
sentences.zh: 我们的主要目标是引起关注。

sentences.en: They say in English that east-west, north-south, home is always beSt.
sentences.zh: 英国人说，东好西好，不如家里好。

sentences.en: Because I don't believe somebody should be a refugee forever.
sentences.zh: 因为我认为任何人都不应该永远成为难民。

sentences.en: Just listening to him talk, it was interesting because I knew that he was under duress.
sentences.zh: 仅仅听他说话就很有趣，因为我知道他是在胁迫下说话。

sentences.en: But he was still finding a way to criticize the government and highlight the plight of Hutu refugees and other exiles like himself.
sentences.zh: 但他仍在寻找方法批评政府，并凸显胡图族难民和其他像他这样的流亡者的困境。

sentences.en: As I said, our message was a wake-up call to the international community, international organizations, foreign countries, in Rwanda itself, to remind that we also exiSt.
sentences.zh: 正如我所说，我们的信息是对国际社会、国际组织、外国以及卢旺达本身的警钟，提醒大家我们也存在。

sentences.en: And I believe that one day my message will be heard and understood.
sentences.zh: 我相信总有一天我的信息会被听到和理解。

sentences.en: And given how other critics of Kagame and his government have been treated, I just couldn't help but wonder if this was going to be his last interview that he ever does.
sentences.zh: 鉴于卡加梅及其政府的其他批评者受到的待遇，我忍不住想这会不会是他做的最后一次采访。

sentences.en: I just kept thinking, would this be the final message that he ever has to deliver to the rest of the world?
sentences.zh: 我一直在想，这会是他向全世界传递的最后一条信息吗？

sentences.en: Thank you so much for doing it.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你接受采访。

sentences.en: I appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我很感激。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: And good luck.
sentences.zh: 祝你好运。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: So after the interview with Paul Roussa Sabagina, I was able to meet with two top government officials who had been behind his arreSt.
sentences.zh: 在采访了保罗·鲁斯萨巴吉纳之后，我得以见到了幕后主导逮捕他的两位高级政府官员。

sentences.en: They were the country's chief spy, Joseph Zabamuita and Johnstone Businger, who is the justice minister.
sentences.zh: 他们是该国首席间谍约瑟夫·扎巴穆塔和司法部长约翰斯通·布辛格。

sentences.en: And they want to go actually on record in terms of how Paul Roussa Sabagina got to Kigali.
sentences.zh: 他们实际上希望公开记录保罗·鲁斯萨巴吉纳是如何到达基加利的。

sentences.en: And we go into a conference room, we bump elbows as a way of greeting, we all sat down and then the interview began.
sentences.zh: 我们走进一间会议室，以碰肘的方式打招呼，大家都坐了下来，然后采访就开始了。

sentences.en: Thanks for taking the time.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你抽出时间。

sentences.en: Thanks for taking the time.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你抽出时间。

sentences.en: I appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我很感激。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Maybe I should give you the chance first of all.
sentences.zh: 也许我应该首先把机会交给你。

sentences.en: So like, if you want to say something about it and then I can get on to my questions.
sentences.zh: 就像，如果你想先说点什么，然后我再问我的问题。

sentences.en: Well, it was quite flawless and I should say one of the best operations that any country can ever conduct.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这相当完美，我可以说这是任何国家都能开展的最好的行动之一。

sentences.en: The thing that has stayed with me up until now is how the intelligence chief was...
sentences.zh: 直到现在，一直留在我脑海里的是这位情报长官当时……

sentences.en: That's why I told you that this was one of the best intelligence operations.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么我告诉你这是最好的情报行动之一。

sentences.en: He was just gleeful.
sentences.zh: 他简直兴高采烈。

sentences.en: His face was beaming.
sentences.zh: 他满面红光。

sentences.en: He was smiling.
sentences.zh: 他在笑。

sentences.en: No, but you didn't matter how to execute this.
sentences.zh: 不，但你当时不知道如何执行这个任务。

sentences.en: I actually executed it right from the planning to full execution when he landed in Kigali.
sentences.zh: 我实际上从策划一直到他在基加利降落的全过程都亲自执行了。

sentences.en: He essentially admitted that the Rwandan government had been tracking Paul Roussa Sabagina's movements.
sentences.zh: 他基本上承认卢旺达政府一直在追踪保罗·鲁斯萨巴吉纳的行踪。

sentences.en: He went for his COVID test, bought his air ticket.
sentences.zh: 他去做了新冠检测，买了机票。

sentences.en: And it suddenly became clear to me that the main reason the spy chief was giving me an interview
sentences.zh: 我突然明白，这位情报主管接受我采访的主要原因

sentences.en: was because they were very proud of what they had done and they wanted the world to know.
sentences.zh: 是因为他们对自己所做的事感到非常自豪，并希望全世界都知道。

sentences.en: So he delivered himself here.
sentences.zh: 所以他把自己送到了这里。

sentences.en: We got Paul Roussa Sabagina here.
sentences.zh: 我们把保罗·鲁斯萨巴吉纳弄到这里来了。

sentences.en: And as the chief spy was explaining and gloating about this elaborate process...
sentences.zh: 正当这位首席间谍在解释并沾沾自喜于这个精心策划的过程时……

sentences.en: What he has to account for is, one, he declared war.
sentences.zh: 他必须交代的一点是，首先，他宣战了。

sentences.en: The justice minister was there to basically say...
sentences.zh: 司法部长当时在场，基本上是为了说……

sentences.en: Two, he made good on his promise.
sentences.zh: 第二，他兑现了他的承诺。

sentences.en: His forces attacked.
sentences.zh: 他的部队发动了袭击。

sentences.en: This was all legal.
sentences.zh: 这一切都是合法的。

sentences.en: This was all justified.
sentences.zh: 这一切都是正当的。

sentences.en: And this was not a kidnapping.
sentences.zh: 这不是绑架。

sentences.en: We were at war with FLN.
sentences.zh: 我们与民族解放阵线处于战争状态。

sentences.en: FLN, he subscribes, he leads, he finances.
sentences.zh: 民族解放阵线，他支持、领导、资助。

sentences.en: He does many things around FLN.
sentences.zh: 他围绕民族解放阵线做了很多事情。

sentences.en: So we were at war.
sentences.zh: 所以我们处于战争状态。

sentences.en: And he is like, any country in the world would do this and it would not be a problem.
sentences.zh: 他的意思是，世界上任何国家都会这么做，而且这不会是个问题。

sentences.en: So it should not be a problem that Rwanda did this.
sentences.zh: 所以卢旺达这么做也不应该是个问题。

sentences.en: When you declare war, at some point you need to expect that the other party on whom you are launching a war is also going to fight back.
sentences.zh: 当你宣战时，你在某种程度上需要预期向你发动战争的另一方也会进行反击。

sentences.en: Because the things he did,
sentences.zh: 因为他所做的事，

sentences.en: this government wanted him to come and answer for the things he was doing.
sentences.zh: 本届政府希望他来对自己的所作所为作出交代。

sentences.en: There is no country that I know which will turn one cheek, you slap, then turn the other cheek, you slap, then turn the other cheek, continue turning cheeks for you to slap.
sentences.zh: 据我所知，没有任何一个国家会把左脸转过来让你扇，接着把右脸转过来让你扇，然后继续转过脸让你扇。

sentences.en: There's no country that I know, certainly not here.
sentences.zh: 据我所知，没有哪个国家会这样，这里绝对不会。

sentences.en: And so what do you make of what the justice minister has just told you?
sentences.zh: 那么你对司法部长刚才对你说的话有什么看法？

sentences.en: Michael, what I make of that reaction is that the Rwandan government is going to go after anybody who is threatening its stability, whatever they are in the world.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，我对这种反应的看法是，卢旺达政府将追捕任何威胁其稳定的人，无论他们在世界的哪个角落。

sentences.en: It was a scary message, honestly, to listen to.
sentences.zh: 老实说，听到这样的话令人感到害怕。

sentences.en: Particularly, I think it was being delivered to all the Kagame critics all across the world.
sentences.zh: 特别是，我认为这是向世界各地的所有卡加梅批评者发出的信号。

sentences.en: Thanks.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Wish you were the beSt.
sentences.zh: 祝你一切都好。

sentences.en: Thanks.

sentences.en: So, Abdi, it has now been many years of these two men trying to establish these competing stories of Rwanda on the international stage.
sentences.zh: 阿卜迪，这两个人试图在国际舞台上确立这些相互对立的卢旺达叙事，现在已经持续多年了。

sentences.en: And given that Paul Rusesabagina is now inside a Rwandan prison for what could be a very long time, where does that leave them?
sentences.zh: 鉴于保罗·鲁斯萨巴吉纳现在被关押在卢旺达的监狱里，而且可能会关很长时间，这让他们处于什么境地？

sentences.en: Where does that leave Rwanda?
sentences.zh: 这把卢旺达置于何地？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Paul Rusesabagina, for now, he lingers in a prison in Rwanda.
sentences.zh: 就目前而言，保罗·鲁斯萨巴吉纳仍在卢旺达的一所监狱里苦熬。

sentences.en: He's basically lost everything.
sentences.zh: 他基本上失去了所有东西。

sentences.en: And meanwhile, Paul Kagame and his government are still in tight control of the country.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，保罗·卡加梅和他的政府仍然对该国保持着铁腕控制。

sentences.en: Since the genocide and under his leadership, for whatever tactics he's used, he's been able to bring back the country from the brink.
sentences.zh: 自大屠杀以来在他的领导下，无论他使用了什么策略，他都成功地将这个国家从崩溃的边缘拉了回来。

sentences.en: But on the other hand, you have these Hutu-Tutsi ethnic tensions that have been there for decades and are escalating.
sentences.zh: 但另一方面，你又有几十年来一直存在并正在升级的胡图族与图西族之间的种族紧张局势。

sentences.en: So it all feels like a ticking bomb.
sentences.zh: 所以这一切感觉就像一颗定时炸弹。

sentences.en: Paul Kagame is trying to build this country where ethnicity doesn't exist and that Rwandans progress as one strong nation.
sentences.zh: 保罗·卡加梅正试图建立这样一个国家：在这里种族不存在，卢旺达人作为一个强大的国家共同进步。

sentences.en: On the contrast, like you have Paul Rusesabagina who is saying, the system that you've created is not an inclusive system.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，就像保罗·鲁斯萨巴吉纳所说的那样，你建立的系统并不是一个具有包容性的系统。

sentences.en: It needs a lot of reform.
sentences.zh: 它需要进行大量的改革。

sentences.en: And so Paul Kagame and Paul Rusesabagina, you can see them as symbols of the divisions in the country.
sentences.zh: 因此，保罗·卡加梅和保罗·鲁斯萨巴吉纳，你可以把他们看作是国家分裂的象征。

sentences.en: And these divisions at some point will have to be reconciled.
sentences.zh: 卢旺达要想向前发展，这些分歧在某种程度上必须得到调解。

sentences.en: They will have to be healed one way or another if Rwanda is going to move forward.
sentences.zh: 不管用什么方法，它们都必须得到弥合，卢旺达才能前进。

sentences.en: Abdi, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 阿卜迪，非常感谢。

sentences.en: Thank you, Michael.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，迈克尔。

sentences.en: On Wednesday, Paul Rusesabagina, wearing a mask and a pink prison uniform,
sentences.zh: 周三，保罗·鲁斯萨巴吉纳戴着口罩和粉红色囚服，

sentences.en: arrived at the Supreme Court of Rwanda for the start of his trial.
sentences.zh: 抵达卢旺达最高法院开始受审。

sentences.en: Among other things, he faces the charge of being a member of a terrorist organization.
sentences.zh: 除其他指控外，他面临加入恐怖组织的罪名。

sentences.en: His prosecution has been roundly criticized by human rights groups and the international community, including the European Parliament and 37 members of the U.S.
sentences.zh: 他的起诉遭到人权组织和国际社会的普遍批评，包括欧洲议会和美国37名议员，

sentences.en: Congress, who issued a letter calling on President Kagame to release him.
sentences.zh: 他们发表了一封信，呼吁卡加梅总统释放他。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他消息。

sentences.en: A dangerous new winter storm was headed for Texas on Wednesday night, even as the state struggled to restore electricity from the last storm.
sentences.zh: 周三晚间，一场危险的新冬季风暴正袭向德克萨斯州，尽管该州仍在艰难恢复上一场风暴带来的电力供应。

sentences.en: Millions of Texans remained without power as brutally cold weather battered the state's electrical grid, freezing natural gas pipelines, wind turbines, and power lines.
sentences.zh: 由于残酷的寒冷天气破坏了该州的电网，导致天然气管道、风力涡轮机和输电线路冻结，数百万德州人依然处于断电状态。

sentences.en: I want to address an issue that some Texans are already beginning to deal with, but many Texans will be having to deal with here in the coming days,
sentences.zh: 我想谈谈一个问题，一些德州人已经开始应对这个问题，但许多德州人将在未来几天不得不应对这个问题，

sentences.en: and that is the results of busted pipes.
sentences.zh: 那就是水管破裂的后果。

sentences.en: During a news conference,
sentences.zh: 在一次新闻发布会上，

sentences.en: Texas' governor, Greg Abbott, resorted to advising homeowners without power to manually turn off their water supply to avoid having pipes freeze, burst, and flood their homes.
sentences.zh: 德克萨斯州州长格雷格·阿博特建议无电可用的房主手动关闭供水，以避免水管冻裂并淹没他们的房屋。

sentences.en: If you are a homeowner, there should be a location, typically outside, maybe near the curbside, where you have the ability to physically turn off the water supply to your house.
sentences.zh: 如果你是一名房主，应该有一个位置，通常在室外，也许在路边附近，你可以在那里亲手切断房屋的供水。

sentences.en: You can turn it off at the time of your choosing.
sentences.zh: 你可以在你选择的时间将其关闭。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个受严密控制的机器在运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 当时选举迎来了自称改革派的一群人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党陷入了一场激烈、混乱、有时甚至令人兴奋的斗争中。
